summary: The PROGRESS.json rewrite landed as commit d60e2483f2fe7671c6dfef98a025375bfb2376d5 (blob c9669f2a, receipt mw8nseqi-f04c8xvk.2), and its push-triggered run 42552951167 concluded success in 16s on venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1, so the durable fallback now records t2 complete with the spec audit base 68c6f2a8 versus live main c30c23be delta. The audit spec read this turn confirms the exact 11-column REQUIREMENTS.csv contract, the GANTT_COMPARISON.csv columns, and that EVIDENCE.json must distinguish claimed receipt from independently read artifact. This turn adds docs/venice-audit-v1/build_extra.py (REQUIREMENTS.csv stages 0-8, GANTT_COMPARISON.csv parsed from the baseline JSON so no chart row can be lost, EVIDENCE.json entries E1-E8) and wires it into build_matrices.py, keeping DATA_REQUIREMENTS.csv output byte-stable for the 7 existing tests. Nothing merged; no gate opened.
